mapper.insert: insert into CHB_EQUDET_CHECK_RESULT(SEQNO,EQUITY_CONF_DATE,CHECK_RESULT, PRODID,PRODNAME,PRD_REGIST_CODE,INDENTIFY_MARK, CCY,TDYQTY,YSTQTY,CHANGEQTY,UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_USER,CREATE_TIME,CREATE_DEPT) select UUID() SEQNO, r.* from ( select todayData.HOLD_DATE EQUITY_CONF_DATE, /*查询日期*/ case when todayData.QTY <> (ifnull(todayDataDetail.shares,0) + ifnull(lastDayData.QTY, 0)) then '01' else '02' end CHECK_RESULT,/*检查结果*/ todayData.PRODID PRODID, /*产品代码*/ P.PRODNAME PRODNAME, /*产品名称*/ P.REG_CODE PRD_REGIST_CODE, /*产品登记编码*/ todayData.INDENTIFY_MARK INDENTIFY_MARK, /*识别标识*/ todayData.CCY CCY, /*币种*/ todayData.QTY TDYQTY, /*当日持有份额*/ ifnull(lastDayData.QTY, 0) YSTQTY, /*前一日持有份额*/ todayDataDetail.shares CHANGEQTY,/*当日明细变动份额*/ P.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, now() UPDATE_TIME, P.CREATE_USER, now() CREATE_TIME, P.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT from (SELECT A.REGIST_BANK_CODE, A.PRODID, A.HOLD_DATE, A.CCY, SUM(A.QTY) QTY, A.INDENTIFY_MARK FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO A where A.STATUS != 'D' AND date_format(A.HOLD_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') =#{date,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY A.REGIST_BANK_CODE, A.PRODID, A.HOLD_DATE, A.CCY, a.indentify_mark) todayData left join (SELECT A.REGIST_BANK_CODE, A.PRODID, A.HOLD_DATE, A.CCY, A.INDENTIFY_MARK, SUM(A.QTY) QTY FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO A where A.STATUS != 'D' GROUP BY A.REGIST_BANK_CODE, A.PRODID, A.HOLD_DATE, A.CCY, a.indentify_mark) lastDayData on todayData.REGIST_BANK_CODE = lastDayData.REGIST_BANK_CODE and todayData.PRODID = lastDayData.PRODID AND adddate(todayData.HOLD_DATE, interval -1 day) = lastDayData.HOLD_DATE AND todayData.CCY = lastDayData.CCY and todayData.indentify_mark = lastDayData.indentify_mark left join (select t.reg_code, t.account, t.REGIST_BANK_CODE, t.indentify_mark, t.ccy, t.equity_conf_date, sum(case when t.busi_type = '03' then - 1 * t.shares when t.busi_type = '11' then - 1 * t.shares when t.busi_type = '13' then - 1 * t.shares when t.busi_type = '15' then - 1 * t.shares when t.busi_type = '16' then - 1 * t.shares else t.shares end ) shares /*当日变动份额*/ from chb_equdet t where t.STATUS != 'D' and t.busi_type not in ('06','07','08','09') /*徽商个性化,冻结，不影响份额。不纳入计算*/ group by t.REGIST_BANK_CODE, t.account, t.ccy, t.indentify_mark, reg_code, equity_conf_date) todayDataDetail on todayData.REGIST_BANK_CODE = todayDataDetail.REGIST_BANK_CODE and todayData.PRODID = todayDataDetail.account AND todayData.HOLD_DATE = todayDataDetail.equity_conf_date AND todayData.CCY = todayDataDetail.CCY and todayData.indentify_mark = todayDataDetail.indentify_mark LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE P ON todayData.PRODID = P.PRODID order by todayData.PRODID, todayData.HOLD_DATE, todayData.CCY )r where r.CHECK_RESULT='01'
